description: SL-R: reorders Solim's results at random, on a trigger; it goes on either side of the Solim module

params.text: Swaps one randomly chosen active output with the one above or below it, wrapping round at the ends
Moves one randomly chosen active output to another position, swapping the two
Reorders all the active outputs at random
Puts every active output back in its original position

inputs.text: Swaps one randomly chosen active output with its neighbour each time it rises to 1V
Moves one randomly chosen active output to another position each time it rises to 1V
Reorders all the active outputs each time it rises to 1V
Puts every output back in its original position each time it rises to 1V

notes: this expander can go on either side of the Solim module, and one on each side is allowed, in which case only the left one acts
the reordering happens after limiting and sorting and before the Output Octaver, whose Re-sort button will undo it
the buttons keep working while the CV inputs are patched, unlike the controls on the other Solim expanders
the order is not saved with the patch, so every output returns to its original position when the patch is reopened
